mintAuthority.summary: TRYB is issued by BiLira using a FiatTokenProxy pattern on Ethereum. The ETH owner is a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (3 signers, 2-of-3, no modules); the masterMinter controlling minting allowances is a separate Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (6 signers, 3-of-6, no modules). The legacy proxy admin is a separate 2-of-3 multisig at 0xfa161fce6c543647cb5ce86d1ee7fa303eb951c4; zero EIP-1967 slots do not establish immutability for this custom proxy.

controls.label: BiLira issuance backend
controls.evidence: BiLira operates the centralized 1:1 mint/redeem for TRYB against TRY cash reserves and manages native deployments across chains; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

controls.label: TRYB ETH owner Safe (2-of-3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294993: owner() on FiatTokenProxy 0x2c537e5624e4af88a7ae4060c022609376c8d0eb returned 0xb9fda3c5a457573535684f591f3e00d949a8dad6. getOwners() confirmed 3 owners; getThreshold() = 2; slot 0 = 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552 (Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 singleton). getModulesPaginated returned empty (next=0x1, arr_len=0). EIP-1967 impl and admin slots both 0x0 (not a proxy in the ERC1967 sense; FiatTokenProxy stores impl in custom slot).

controls.label: TRYB ETH masterMinter Safe (3-of-6)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095805 on 2026-10-01, masterMinter() returned this 3-of-6 Safe, while isMinter(this Safe) returned false. The current verified FiatTokenV2 implementation restricts configureMinter(address,uint256) to onlyMasterMinter and lets it set minters[minter] and minterAllowed[minter]. This Safe administers and can raise mint allowances; it is not currently a direct minter. Current getOwners(), getThreshold(), and getModulesPaginated() confirmed the recorded six owners, threshold three, and no enabled modules.

controls.label: TRYB legacy proxy upgrade admin (2-of-3 multisig)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25580032, the FiatTokenProxy legacy admin slot resolves to 0xfa161fce6c543647cb5ce86d1ee7fa303eb951c4. Its verified MultiSigWalletWithDailyLimit contract reports required() = 2 and getOwners() = three addresses. The proxy implementation slot resolves to FiatTokenV2 at 0x5f88d1a517b670a14ded5d0cf8b3d37e554d977b.

controls.label: TRYB Worldchain legacy proxy upgrade admin Safe (1-of-1)
controls.evidence: At Worldchain block 35751023, TRYB's org.zeppelinos.proxy.admin slot returned this Safe, distinct from the Ethereum 2-of-3 admin. The custom implementation slot returned 0xfd023fb9efe3bee7c1fb54931de1b2e544216f1a. getOwners() returned only 0x8cb445f6bd3ab1513e43500ec41e01bd969f79ce, getThreshold() returned 1, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, getModulesPaginated() returned no modules, and the Safe guard slot was zero.
